trip.legend: What kind of trip are you planning?
trip.subheading: Select your travel purpose to see recommended visa categories, entry privileges, and fees.

tourism.label: Tourism & Sightseeing
tourism.desc: For holidays, visiting friends or family, and casual visits.

business.label: Business & Commercial
business.desc: For attending meetings, conferences, or setting up business.

medical.label: Medical Treatment
medical.desc: For short-term treatment in recognized Indian medical centers.

conference.label: Conference & Seminars
conference.desc: For attending international workshops, government seminars, and symposiums.

student.label: Higher Education & Studies
student.desc: For recognized full-time degree programs or student exchange programs.

work.label: Employment & Work
work.desc: For professional employment, specialized technical assignments, or intra-company transfers.

dependent.passportHint: Enter 2 letters followed by 7 digits exactly as shown on your passport.
dependent.passportError: Please enter a valid passport number (2 letters followed by 7 digits).
dependent.needsAttention: Trip selection was updated. Please re-verify your passport details.

personal.identityDesc: Enter details exactly as they appear in the machine-readable bio-data page of your passport.
personal.contactDesc: Provide active contact information where you can receive OTPs, receipt SMS, and status updates.
personal.visaSpecificDesc: Tell us about your scheduled travel itinerary and local accommodations.
personal.privacyBannerDesc: All personal information and documents stay encrypted on your device until final submission. Zero third-party sharing.

fields.givenNameHint: Include middle names if listed under Given Names on passport.
fields.surnameHint: If you have only a single name, enter it under Given Name.
fields.passportNumberHint: Found at the top-right corner of your passport biographical page.

documents.title: Supporting Documents
documents.subtitle: Upload clear, un-cropped photos or digital PDFs. Automatic compression optimizes file sizes for 3G networks.
documents.formatHint: JPG, PNG, or PDF up to 5MB (compressed to ≤2MB)

photo.title: Passport-Sized Photograph
photo.description: Recent color photograph with white background, clear face, neutral expression, and no glare.

passportFront.title: Passport Bio-Data Page (Front)
passportFront.description: Clear scan or photo of the page containing your photo, name, passport number, and MRZ lines.

passportBack.title: Passport Address Page (Back)
passportBack.description: Scan or photo showing address, father/mother name, and place of issue.

flightItinerary.title: Flight Booking / Travel Itinerary
flightItinerary.description: Confirmed round-trip flight booking or provisional itinerary with flight numbers.

hotelBooking.title: Hotel / Accommodation Confirmation
hotelBooking.description: Proof of accommodation, hotel reservation voucher, or host invitation letter.

bankStatement.title: Bank Statement / Proof of Funds
bankStatement.description: Recent 3-6 months bank statement showing adequate financial balance for travel.

invitationLetter.title: Official Business / Academic Invitation Letter
invitationLetter.description: Letter on official letterhead from host organization stating purpose of visit.

review.title: Application Summary
review.subtitle: Review all entered information carefully before submitting and paying the processing fee.
review.declarationText: I declare that all particulars given in this application are true, correct, and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief. I understand that false statements will lead to visa refusal or cancellation.

paymentMethods.upi: UPI Instant Payment (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM)

confirmation.title: Application Successfully Submitted!
confirmation.subtitle: Your visa application has been securely transmitted. Save your reference numbers below.
confirmation.trackingNotice: SMS and Email updates have been dispatched to your registered contact details.
